meta.source: US Census Bureau, TIGER/Line Shapefiles, County Subdivisions (New Jersey municipalities)
meta.coordinates: [longitude, latitude], NAD83 (EPSG:4269); differs from WGS84 GPS by about 1 m in New Jersey
meta.polygons: Each town is a list of polygons; each polygon is [outer ring, ...holes]; rings are closed

simplification.note: Borders move at most tolerance plus rounding; neighboring towns are simplified separately, so tiny gaps or overlaps (under ~20 m) can exist along shared borders.

selection.rule: Towns containing an NJ Transit bus stop of lines 163/164/165, plus towns sharing a border with them
